description: We are a team of curious, creative, and motivated students participating this global Hackathon.We are passionate about space exploration, science,and learning new things. Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” explores the history of human-made hardware left across the Solar System and aims to make space knowledge more engaging and accessible. We are still developing our technical skills, but we are eager to learn, experiment, and improve together.
summary: Avinasa is an interactive educational project about human-made hardware left behind on the Moon, Mars, and beyond. Through storytelling and timelines, we help users discover forgotten space objects, the missions behind them, and their scientific significance. Our project addresses NASA’s challenge by making space exploration history engaging and accessible to young learners. We aim to show that these objects are not simply abandoned equipment but important pieces of humanity’s space exploration legacy.
details: Our project, “Abandoned, But Not Forgotten,” is an interactive educational platform about human-made hardware left on the Moon, Mars, and other places in space. It uses storytelling, timelines, and visual content to make space history interesting and accessible. Our goal is to raise awareness of space heritage and inspire curiosity about space exploration. We developed it using Superintelligence, Bolt.new, and Google research resources, focusing on creativity, accessibility, and educational value.
